rationale.conceptual: The method uses standard DFT with a specific functional/basis, then applies documented scaling and unit conversion to derive molecular mechanics parameters. The procedure is multi-step and requires careful handling of internal coordinate definitions, dihedral multiplicities, and charge redistribution, but no novel algorithms are needed.
rationale.execution: The workflow involves building eight cluster models, running DFT geometry optimization and frequency calculations, extracting Hessian diagonal elements, applying scaling factors and unit conversions, and compiling a CSV. This spans ~3 main stages with several sub-operations and depends on external tools (ORCA, Multiwfn), making it a moderately complex pipeline.
